description: This file defines the `HolidayService` class, providing functionalities related to managing holidays within the Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for saving, searching, and deleting holidays, as well as checking if a specific date is a holiday or half-day. The service interacts with the data access object (DAO) layer and employs caching to optimize holiday retrieval operations.

classes.name: HolidayService
classes.description: Provides services for holiday management, including CRUD operations, holiday searches with caching, and holiday type checks based on date.

methods.name: getHolidayDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the HolidayDao instance used for database operations related to holidays.

methods.name: saveHoliday
methods.description: Saves a holiday entity and clears the relevant cache.

methods.name: searchHolidays
methods.description: Returns a list of holidays matching the search filter, applying pagination if specified.

methods.name: searchHolidaysCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of holidays matching the search filter.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a specific date is a full-day holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if a specific date is a half-day holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a specific date is a half-day holiday based on holiday length.

methods.name: deleteHolidays
methods.description: Deletes holidays based on provided IDs and clears cache.
